senses.en: someone who attacks cherished ideas or traditional institutions
senses.ko: 우상 파괴자, 기존 관습에 도전하는 사람

examples.text: The young architect was an iconoclast who rejected every convention of the classical tradition.

senses.en: a destroyer of images used in religious worship

examples.text: Medieval iconoclasts smashed the statues and defaced the paintings that filled the cathedral.

origin.ko: 중세 그리스어 eikonoklástēs '성상 파괴자'에서 왔습니다. 형상(icon)을 부수는(clast) 사람이 기존 관습에 맞서는 사람이 되었습니다.

senses.en: characterized by attack on established beliefs or institutions

examples.text: Many of Thomas Hardy's works were considered iconoclastic in his day.

origin.ko: iconoclast(성상 파괴자)의 형용사형입니다. 형상을 깨뜨리듯 기존 통념을 부순다는 뜻입니다.
